title: Fix incorrect recursion for dir=auto special cases.

labels.name: topic: shadow
labels.description: Relates to shadow trees (as defined in DOM)

labels.name: i18n-tracker
labels.description: Group bringing to attention of Internationalization, or tracked by i18n but not needing response.

body: dir=auto has special-case behavior for both (1) auto-directionality form-associated elements and (2) slots with assigned nodes. In these special cases dir=auto is intended to have special behavior when used on the element, but this special behavior was not intended to apply when dir=auto was used on an ancestor. The wording in the HTML spec for this behavior got this incorrect for at least one case, where the handling of the slot case needs recursion over the assigned nodes as though they were descendants. This was uncovered by the Gecko implementor adding a test for this case as described in https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1876163#c13 . I believe this was a mistake in the spec and is fixed in this change by splitting "contained text auto directionality" into a separate algorithm and invoking that, rather than the complete "auto directionality" algorithm, when handling an Element assigned to a slot. This special case handling also incorrectly missed applying exclusions of descendants (for a different set of special cases) to the special traversal for computing dir=auto on a slot element, which traverses its assigned nodes (in order) rather than its descendants. This change also fixes that exclusion by adding a canExcludeRoot boolean to the "contained text auto directionality" algorithm. This is a followup to PR #9796 (fixing #3699). Fixes #10488. - [X] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium * Mozilla (per https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10561#pullrequestreview-2246096254 ) - [X] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/47670 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/47678 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/47697 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/47743 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: already fixed in [crrev.com/c/5796604](https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/5796604), [crrev.com/c/5798082](https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/5798082), and [crrev.com/c/5798880](https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/5798880) * Gecko: [bug 1914062](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1914062) * WebKit: existing [bug 267951](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=267951) should be sufficient since it hasn't been fixed yet - [X] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: existing https://github.com/mdn/content/issues/45249 should be sufficient - [X] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
